name: Ternary-Bonsai-2-27B-Pulse

benchmarks.note: Measured on an idle NVIDIA GB10, llama-speculative-simple, temp 0, --ignore-eos, realistic code context, 3-5 repeats. Nothing extrapolated. See https://github.com/usmaneth/pulse/blob/main/bench/RESULTS.md
benchmarks.device: NVIDIA GB10 (48 SMs, sm_121, 121.7 GB unified LPDDR5X, CUDA 13.0)

highest_acceptance.note: reproducible to the digit over 5 runs; acceptance is prompt-dependent (21%-96% observed across workloads)

hardware_ceiling.note: measured with a model-free n-gram drafter at 100% acceptance

corrections: Earlier manifests claimed 141.28 tok/s single-stream, 206.50 peak, 525 tok/s MoE and 495.20 aggregate across 16 subagents. None were measured. A later revision quoted 73.00 tok/s, which was a single best run rather than a median, and 646 tok/s prefill taken with an untuned batch setting. All are superseded by the measured values above.
